summary: Confirmed a deliverable boundary defect: a=1, b=0 produces x0 instead of x. Both previous findings are resolved. The runner’s current batch is valid; package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Integrate n/(ax+b) using substitution and select its antiderivative.
reasoning_steps: Set u=ax+b and identify slope a.
invariants: One constant numerator and nonconstant affine denominator.
Five radio choices with one correct antiderivative.
Absolute-value logarithm and additive integration constant.
permitted_variations: Small coefficients, slope signs and intercepts, including zero.
Correct coefficient rank, logarithm argument and answer position.

source_replay.details: All six source banks replay. Canonical prompt and solution match. Missing q-49511 key and solution were explicitly reconstructed and independently checked.

math.details: Parameters [2,1,0] produce 2/x0 and 2 ln|x0|+C. CLI seed 575 produces five defective records, all surviving delivery. Sixty other checked records pass independent differentiation.

variety.details: Both bank profiles vary answer-bearing roles and support positive nonunit slopes. The zero-intercept formatting defect is assessed separately.

scope.details: The construction preserves easy single-affine substitution and the source response contract.

grading.details: Native radio grading accepted 60 independently verified correct choices and rejected 240 distractors. It also accepts the malformed record’s declared UUID, confirming that grading does not block the content defect.

rendering.details: The actual UI visibly displays x0 throughout the defective question and solution. Automatic MathJax checks pass despite the incorrect mathematics.

packaging.details: Exact dependencies, deterministic replay, declared-file relocation and invalid-request rejection pass. Previous regressions fail on the old package and pass on the revision. Package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Controlled target changes update prompts, keys, solutions and grading; option reordering preserves responses. All five delivered batch choices become keys, and the prior shortcut succeeds 0/5. Captured inventory contains no generated records.

findings.description: The shared denominator formatter emits x0 for a=1, b=0. This corrupts prompts, logarithm arguments and solutions, including the false claim d(x0)/dx=1. Normal generation reaches this case, and delivery filtering accepts it.

findings.requested_change: Fix denom(a,b) to render zero intercept correctly, including unit slope, across prompts, choices and solutions. Preserve zero-intercept practice. Adopt the retained regression and test zero intercept with unit, negative and nonunit slopes, including actual UI rendering.
